title: SUNDAY MOBILITY
subtitle: SUNDAY. MOBILITY DAY. OPEN THE CHEST, HAMSTRINGS, AND HIPS. OWN THE BALANCE. LIGHT CORE AT THE END. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. SUNDAY. MOBILITY DAY. SIXTEEN MINUTES. OPEN THE CHEST, HAMSTRINGS, AND HIPS. OWN THE BALANCE. LIGHT CORE TO FINISH. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THAT KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. SUNDAY MOBILITY DONE. CHEST OPEN. HIPS HONEST. BALANCE OWNED. NOW GET BACK TO WORK WITHOUT SITTING LIKE A BLOODY FOLDED DECKCHAIR.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: FOREARM OR OPEN PALM ON THE WALL AT SHOULDER HEIGHT. STAND TALL. GENTLY TURN THE CHEST AWAY UNTIL YOU FEEL THE FRONT OF THE SHOULDER AND CHEST. SWITCH SIDES WITHIN THE ROUND. BREATHE. THIS IS YOUR CHEST OPENER. DO NOT FORCE IT.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENERS. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS. HAND ON THE WALL. EASE THE CHEST OPEN. SWITCH SIDES. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. DO NOT WRENCH IT LIKE YOU ARE PRIZING OPEN A BLOODY JAM JAR.

exercises.name: STANDING HAMSTRING REACH
exercises.cue: STAND TALL. SOFT KNEE ON ONE LEG. HINGE AT THE HIPS AND REACH TOWARD THE FRONT FOOT UNTIL YOU FEEL THE BACK OF THE THIGH. SWITCH SIDES WITHIN THE ROUND. BREATHE. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. DO NOT FORCE IT.
exercises.speakStart: STANDING HAMSTRING REACHES. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS. SOFT KNEE. HINGE AND REACH. FEEL THE BACK OF THE THIGH. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE HAULING IN A BLOODY FISHING NET.

exercises.name: STATIC HIP-FLEXOR STRETCH
exercises.cue: LONG HALF-KNEELING OR STANDING SPLIT STANCE. BACK KNEE SOFT OR DOWN. TUCK THE TAIL SLIGHTLY AND SHIFT FORWARD UNTIL YOU FEEL THE FRONT OF THE BACK HIP. BREATHE. HIP OPENER. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: STATIC HIP FLEXOR STRETCHES. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. LONG STANCE. EASE INTO THE FRONT OF THE BACK HIP. THIS IS YOUR HIP OPENER. DO NOT FORCE IT LIKE YOU ARE WRENCHING A BLOODY STUCK HINGE.

exercises.name: STANDING FIGURE-FOUR
exercises.cue: STAND TALL. CROSS ONE ANKLE OVER THE OPPOSITE KNEE. SOFT BEND IN THE STANDING LEG. SIT BACK SLIGHTLY UNTIL YOU FEEL THE OUTER HIP. LIGHT FINGERTIPS ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. BREATHE. YOGA-STYLE HIP OPENER. DO NOT FORCE DEPTH.
exercises.speakStart: STANDING FIGURE FOURS. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. ANKLE OVER KNEE. SIT BACK GENTLY. FEEL THE OUTER HIP. THIS IS YOUR YOGA STYLE OPENER. DO NOT FORCE IT LIKE YOU ARE CRAMMING A BLOODY SUITCASE SHUT.
exercises.speakRest: FIFTEEN. SWITCH SIDES. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG STAND
exercises.cue: STAND TALL. ONE FOOT OFF THE FLOOR. SOFT KNEE ON THE STANDING LEG. LIGHT FINGERTIPS ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. EYES FORWARD. OWN IT.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG STANDS. TWO ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS EACH LEG. ONE FOOT UP. SOFT KNEE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT TOPPLE LIKE A BLOODY DRUNK AT CLOSING TIME.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY. SWITCH LEGS. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. ARMS UP. KNEES BENT OVER HIPS. LOWER OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG TOWARD THE FLOOR WITHOUT ARCHING THE LOW BACK. SWITCH SIDES. LIGHT CORE. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUGS. TWO SETS. EIGHT EACH SIDE. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. LOW BACK FLAT. LIGHT CORE. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY BEACHED WHALE.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP BREATHING. I'M WATCHING.
exercises.speakDone: DEAD BUGS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
